snippet.title: Survive the Squallies — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Survive the Squallies on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5202530/Survive_the_Squallies/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer
Play the free Prologue on itch.io: https://muckaluckastudios.itch.io/survive-the-squallies-prologue

Settle into a new home, go fishing, and meet the neighbors in this retro first-person horror game. Something is watching from the woods. Explore, run, and hide as Bill discovers that getting home alive is harder than fitting in.

I'm making Survive the Squallies on my own at Muckalucka Studios. A free standalone Prologue comes first, then the full game.

Website: https://www.muckaluckastudios.com/
itch.io: https://muckaluckastudios.itch.io/
Support the studio on Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/muckaluckastudios
X: https://x.com/MuckaluckaGames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/muckaluckastudios/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61594808723803

Music: "Dreamcore Music 3" by juanjo_sound, licensed through the Unity Asset Store.

#SurviveTheSquallies #IndieHorror #PSXHorror
